text:
Sam Torres: Hey team — Sam here, first day! Quick question to get set up: who is the service steward/owner for `embed-proxy`? Also who should I CC for infra access (SSH, Vault) and who owns the pager so I can shadow this week? Thanks!

Lara Kim: welcome Sam :wave: I’ll assign a buddy. For infra access start with the access-requests form and cc @Devon Ho. People Ops will handle badge/mac.

Devon Ho: Hey Sam — I’m your buddy, I’ll DM you. Short checklist: open the access-requests ticket with service=embed-proxy, env=staging, reason=onboarding. Example: ```service: embed-proxy
env: staging
reason: onboarding shadow week``` I’ll add you to infra-requests and ping Owen for pager handoff.

Owen Chen: FYI eng-oncall owns the embed-proxy pager currently. I’m the primary this rotation. Shadow plan: sit with me Tue/Wed during the 11:00 run-through, then we’ll add you to the rota for read-only. If you need immediate perms for logs, @Maya Patel can give SLO context.

Maya Patel: runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/embed-proxy-runbook — contains escalation matrix and playbook. Short escalation flow: alert -> eng-oncall (#eng-oncall) -> platform lead (Owen) -> incident execs. If it’s customer-impacting for private deploys, loop CSMs too.

Sam Torres: perfect — thanks everyone. One more: for private deployment customer emergency contact, who is primary?

Owen Chen: primary on-call for infra issues is Maya for now; customer escalations go via Grace from CSMs — I’ll DM Grace and add you to the thread.

Oncall Bot: [system] embed-proxy pager policy: 24/7 rotation, 2 responders. Next rotation start: 2024-09-05. Current primary: Owen Chen.

Sam Torres: great — I’ll open the access ticket now and book the shadow sessions. Appreciate the quick answers!
